summary: v5 retires the two stale Documentation/v0.2 docs (architecture.md, type-system.md) as redirect stubs to the in-tree start.md tree, and removes the non-existent Data.Merge() from CLAUDE.md via the proposal workflow (Ingi: "retire and yes and as claude proposal"). Earlier: v1-v4 built the full in-tree C#-developer doc tree — a start.md next to every top-level app concept's this.cs, drafted by Haiku subagents and verified. The changes/findings below span the whole effort.

changes.description: Settings: the app's typed setting class (Name/Environment/Culture/Create), context.Setting.Of<T>(), the defaults/saved/run layering, module settings.
The app store: one SQLite store per app (.data/data.sqlite), the abstract store surface (no IStore interface), the sqlite kind, who owns tables, lazy open.
Snapshots: a dict of Data, the ISnapshot contract, which owners take part, capture/restore, and resume. Built on locked-core surfaces (serializer, app members) without being locked itself.
Background tasks: a goal call on its own; each actor owns a task list; app.Start's Settle waits for them; task.run and isolated frames; cancelled with the actor.
The test subsystem: app.test = current<test, list>; the session gates Mode=Test; discovery/status/From; parallel per-test apps; report + junit/json output.
App-lifetime disposables: App.KeepAlive Add/Remove/DisposeAsync, teardown order, behaviour notes (neutralized from an initial bug-list framing).
Services: one outbound call's I/O scope (channels, identity, parent); app.Services; a service is not an actor.
Warnings: a non-fatal {Key, Message} note (not an item, not on the app root — reached via goal/step/note.Warning); contrast with Error; how __action.Warn raises; written to the .pr warning array.
The parent app: calling a goal in the app that started this plang (goal.Enter -> app.Run when Elsewhere is set), the call/reply wire shape, NoParent/ParentGoalFailed/Timeout.
Shortcuts: a goal under a shortcut/ folder named by its file, read once at launch; name resolution order (own bindings -> shortcut -> app member -> module).

The variable value (locked core): an item = Text + Code (hops); Start/Set; the parser as the one definition of a reference; the four hops (variable/property/index/method); reserved names. Points to call/start.md for the store side.
Retired: replaced the stale overview with a redirect stub to the in-tree start.md tree + good_to_know.md. Stub (not delete) so the legacy v0.2 docs that link here keep working.
Retired: replaced the stale type-system notes with a redirect stub to PLang/app/type/start.md, type/item/start.md, type/item/variable/start.md + good_to_know.md.
Removed the non-existent Data.Merge() from the Data bullet (line 22), applied via the claude-md-proposals workflow. No Merge is defined under PLang/app/data/.

findings.issue: The class summary says tables are created 'on first write', but Get/GetAll/Set/Remove/Exists each run CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, so any verb creates them.
findings.detail: The store page states the actual behaviour.

findings.issue: Comments (~line 33, ~line 71) still name a 'Service' actor and say cancellation cascades to 'User and Service', but there is no Service actor (service is not an actor — actor/Name.cs).
findings.detail: The service page states that a service is not an actor.

findings.issue: Comment ~line 27 says 'No item.@this base' but the goal IS an item (goal/this.Item.cs). (From v3.)
findings.detail: The goal page states the correct fact.

findings.issue: Summary lists 'Merge' among Data's factories but no Merge exists under PLang/app/data/. CLAUDE.md's 'Data ... Merge()' is stale too. (From v3.)
findings.detail: The data page omits Merge. CLAUDE.md fix can be applied by docs in a later pass.

findings.issue: Comments still reference old 'callstack' / 'app.module.goal.Call' names; namespace is app.call. (From v3.)
XML doc on this[System.Type] says 'null on miss' but it returns the clr entity. (From v2.)
findings.detail: The type page documents the actual behaviour.
